question: Where are a hospital within 180 kilometers of Bay Drive Park, Okee, WI in the southeast direction?
sql: WITH park_location AS ( SELECT P.geometry AS geom FROM parks AS P WHERE P.park_name ILIKE '%Bay Drive Park%' AND ST_Intersects(P.geometry::geography, (SELECT R.geometry::geography FROM regions AS R WHERE R.region_name ILIKE '%Okee%' LIMIT 1)) LIMIT 1 ) SELECT pois.poi_name, pois.addr_state, pois.addr_city FROM pois, park_location WHERE pois.amenity = 'hospital' AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry::geography, park_location.geom::geography, 180000) -- 180 kilometers = 180,000 meters AND degrees(ST_Azimuth( ST_Centroid(park_location.geom), ST_Centroid(pois.geometry) )) BETWEEN 112.5 AND 157.5; -- Southeast direction (112.5 to 157.5 degrees)
